summary: A Quote subscription on NIFTY (NSE_INDEX): the master's 99926000 subscribes as NSE|26000, and the index tk snapshot with AliceBlue's change (cv) and percent (pc) becomes an index Quote frame.

notes: An index token loses its 999 prefix on both (aliceblue_adapter.py:575-579; brokers/aliceblue/streaming.rs feed_token).
The desktop takes AliceBlue's own change and percent for the index (cv, pc) over its own derivation (brokers/aliceblue/streaming.rs on_data).

deviations.reason: The web sends AliceBlue's feed time ft unchanged as ltt: epoch seconds, and a string ("1794302700"); the protocol's WebSocket timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md), so the unit is wrong, as for Dhan. The desktop sends the trade time in ms, as a number.

AliceBlue's web adapter sends the change only as change_percent and OI only as total_oi; the canonical price_change follows the adapter (lead decision 2026-11-09): the index_change switch (lane wire) turns it off on an index; until then it is open.

AliceBlue's web adapter sends the change only as change_percent and OI only as total_oi; the canonical price_change_percent follows the adapter (lead decision 2026-11-09): the index_change switch (lane wire) turns it off on an index; until then it is open.
The web's Quote sends volume 0 for an index tick that carries none; a value the broker did not send is left out, never sent as 0 (docs/api/websocket-streaming/quote.md).

The web's Quote sends average_price 0.0 for an index tick that carries none (parsed_data.get("average_price", 0.0)); a value the broker did not send is left out, never sent as 0 (docs/api/websocket-streaming/quote.md).
The web's Quote sends total_oi 0 for an index tick that carries no toi; a value the broker did not send is left out, never sent as 0.
